description:
Browse podcast guests across the catalog, in two opinionated modes:
  - `directory` (default): the guest directory ranked by lifetime appearances (guests with 2+ appearances).
  - `trends`: who's making the rounds right now — guests with appearances on 2+ distinct podcasts in the last 30 days, which surfaces cross-show press tours rather than show regulars. The press-tour shape is enforced: every in-window appearance must be on a different podcast, each needs 5+ minutes of identified speaking time, mononymous catch-all people are excluded, and the in-window rate must be a 2x spike over the guest's lifetime baseline.

`podcast_slug` switches the directory to one show's roster: every guest who has appeared on that podcast, ranked by appearances on the show (one-off guests included). `topic_slug` narrows either corpus mode to guests appearing on episodes about that topic. `occupation`/`field` (with `standing`, `seniority`, `practicing`, `capacity`, `employer`) keep guests by what they know: resolve the words ("doctors", "economists") to codes with `particle_expertise_resolve` first, and on `unresolved_reference` resolve and retry rather than dropping the filter. Every row names the guest's occupation codes, standing and seniority; `include: ["expertise"]` adds their organization.

Guest slugs ARE person slugs — feed them into `particle_podcast_get_guest` for the appearance profile or `particle_person_get` for the person profile.

appeared_since.description: Only guests with an appearance on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601). Directory mode only.

capacity.description: Only guests who know their field in this capacity. Directory mode only.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

employer.description: Only guests whose organization is this company (slug from particle_company_resolve, or a domain). Directory mode only.

field.description: Only guests listed under this ANZSRC 2020 field of research: a code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve (e.g. 'banking-finance-and-investment'). Directory mode only.

include.description: Optional per-guest sections: 'expertise' (widens the occupation codes, standing and seniority every row carries to the fuller one-line read with the organization). Directory mode only.

mode.description: What to return. 'directory' (default): the guest directory ranked by lifetime appearances. 'trends': guests trending right now — appearances on 2+ distinct podcasts in the last 30 days (cross-show press tours, not regulars).

occupation.description: Only guests listed under this occupation: a SOC 2018 or ISCO-08 code, slug or title from particle_expertise_resolve (e.g. 'cardiologists' or '29-1212'). Directory mode only.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

podcast_slug.description: Return one show's guest roster instead of the corpus directory: every guest who has appeared on this podcast, ranked by appearances on the show (no lifetime-appearance floor). Slug from particle_podcast_resolve. Only valid with the default directory mode. A particle.pro or Radar show link also works.

practicing.description: Only guests who still work in the occupation. Needs a detailed SOC 2018 occupation (e.g. '29-1212' Cardiologists). Directory mode only.

seniority.description: Only guests at this seniority or above. Directory mode only.

standing.description: Only guests whose standing is recognized this way: 'established' (conferred by others: a credential, a position, recognition in the field), 'self_described', or 'unverified'. Directory mode only.

topic_slug.description: Restrict to guests with appearances on episodes classified under this topic (slug from particle_topic_browse, e.g. 'technology/artificial-intelligence'). Ignored when podcast_slug is set.

name: particle_podcast_list_guests
